breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly splits the load based on relative axial stiffnesses (AE/L proportions), not equally. It explicitly states 'using the proportion of axial stiffnesses' and computes F1 = (A1·E1)/(A1·E1 + A2·E2) × P, yielding ~13,714 N and ~6,286 N rather than 10,000 N each.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies a single 'common elongation' for both bars (δ = Fi·L/(Ai·Ei), the same for both), stating 'the plates move together' rather than adding the two elongations together. This aligns with the compatibility condition for parallel bars.
